The '''Government House''' was a large building in [[Fort Garnik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] that served as the center of government for the planet. [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Mitraela]], head of the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]], lived and worked in the Government House, and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] maintained a command center in the building.
